name: Tepig

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, take 2 {Fire} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavor:
This Pokémon is a ravenous glutton. It uses its
excellent sense of smell to find food, then cooks
it to a crisp before eating.
